# A So Called Phantom — playable prototype

An open-world ghost-hero adventure built in Godot 4.3: explore Amity Park, go ghost, fly, phase through walls, capture ghosts with the Fenton Thermos and dive into the Ghost Zone. Personalise your ghost form in the Ghost Form Studio.

**Includes:** Story Chapters 1–3 (Lunch Lady, Box Ghost, Skulker, Walker), 12 ghost powers, dynamic city events, an aerial race, 27 collectible artifacts, day/night cycle and save/load. Single-player only for now.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Linux (x86_64) | `ASoCalledPhantom-*-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel + Apple Silicon) | `ASoCalledPhantom-*-macos-universal.zip` |

### Linux
```bash
tar -xzf ASoCalledPhantom-*-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
./ASoCalledPhantom.x86_64
```
Needs OpenGL 3.3 graphics drivers.

### macOS
Unzip and move **A So Called Phantom.app** to Applications. The app is not notarized by Apple, so the first launch is blocked: **right-click the app → Open → Open**, or run:
```bash
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/A So Called Phantom.app"
```

## Controls
WASD move · Mouse camera · **G** go ghost · Space fly/ascend · C descend · Shift boost · LMB ecto blast · 2 shield · 3 phase · 4 ice · Q ghost sense · V invisibility · R Ghostly Wail · hold **E** to talk / capture with the Fenton Thermos · M map · Esc menu. Gamepads supported.
